guides.title: Study 2 Chronicles
guides.description: Follow selected chapters through the book.

steps.title: Solomon seeks wisdom
steps.text: Solomon seeks wisdom at Gibeon. The chapter also describes royal wealth, horses, and trade. Wisdom is requested for public responsibility. Reported wealth is not an independently audited account.

steps.title: Correction and impartial judgment
steps.text: Jehu rebukes Jehoshaphat’s alliance. The king appoints judges and distinguishes religious and royal responsibilities. Justice requires honesty and refusal of bribes. Courage does not remove a judge’s duty to fairness.

steps.title: Exile and Cyrus’s proclamation
steps.text: The final kings face Egyptian and Babylonian power. Jerusalem and the temple fall. Cyrus’s proclamation opens a path toward return. The closing joins judgment with renewed possibility. Its age variants and family terms require comparison with Kings.
